name: Scotch Game
description: An open game that challenges the center early and creates opportunities for quick development and active piece play.

variations.name: Scotch Gambit
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Bc4 Bc5 5. c3 dxc3 6. Bxf7+ Kxf7 7. Qd5+ Kf8 8. Qxc5+ Qe7 9. Qxe7+ Ngxe7 10. Nxc3 d5 11. exd5 Nb4

explanations.Bc4: The bishop develops to c4 and targets f7.
explanations.c3: White offers a pawn to accelerate development and open lines.
explanations.dxc3: Black captures the pawn on c3.
explanations.Bxf7+: White gives check and exposes the black king.
explanations.Qd5+: The queen gives check and gains a tempo.

variations.name: Scotch Gambit – 5.e5 Continuation
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Bc4 Nf6 5. e5 d5 6. Bb5 Ne4 7. Nxd4 Bd7 8. Bxc6 bxc6 9. O-O Bc5 10. f3 Ng5 11. f4 Ne4 12. Be3 Bb6

explanations.e5: White advances the pawn to drive back the black knight.
explanations.Bb5: The bishop develops and puts pressure on the knight.
explanations.Ne4: The black knight occupies an active central square.
explanations.Bd7: The bishop develops and prepares a possible exchange.

variations.name: 4.Ng5 – Knight Sacrifice and Checkmate Trap
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Ng5 h6 5. Nxf7 Kxf7 6. Bc4+ Ke8 7. Qh5+ g6 8. Qxg6+ Ke7 9. Qf7+ Kd6 10. Bf4+ Kc5 11. Qd5+ Kb4 12. Qb5#

explanations.Ng5: The knight puts pressure on f7, but this attack is risky if Black defends accurately.
explanations.h6: Black tries to drive the knight away but allows a serious tactical threat.
explanations.Nxf7: White's knight captures the pawn on f7.
explanations.Bc4+: The bishop continues the attack with check.
explanations.Qh5+: The queen builds a mating net around the black king.

variations.name: Göring Gambit
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. c3 dxc3 5. Bc4 d6 6. Nxc3 Nf6 7. Qb3 Qd7 8. Ng5 Ne5

explanations.c3: White sacrifices a central pawn for rapid development and open lines.
explanations.Bc4: The bishop aims at the f7 square.
explanations.Nxc3: White recaptures with the knight and continues development.
explanations.Qb3: The queen targets the b7 and f7 squares.

variations.name: Schmidt Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 Bb4 6. Nxc6 bxc6 7. Bd3 d5 8. exd5 cxd5 9. O-O O-O 10. Bg5 c6 11. Qf3 Be7 12. Rae1 Re8 13. Ne2 Bg4 14. Qf4 Bd7 15. Nd4 h6 16. Bxh6 gxh6 17. Qxh6 Ne4 18. Rxe4 dxe4 19. Bxe4 Bg5 20. Qh7+ Kf8 21. Qh8+ Ke7

explanations.Nf6: Black develops the knight and puts pressure on e4.
explanations.Bb4: Black develops the bishop and puts pressure on the knight.
explanations.Nxc6: White's knight captures the black knight.

variations.name: Regular Scotch Game
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Nge7 5. Nc3 Nxd4 6. Qxd4 Nc6 7. Qe3 Nb4 8. Bd3 Be7 9. Nd5

explanations.Nge7: Black develops the knight and adopts a different central setup.
explanations.Nxd4: Black's knight captures the white knight.
explanations.Nd5: White's knight occupies an advanced central square.

variations.name: Horwitz Attack
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Qh4 5. Nb5 Bb4+ 6. Bd2 Qxe4+ 7. Be2 Kd8 8. O-O Bxd2 9. Nxd2 Qf4 10. g3 Qh6 11. Nc4 Nge7

explanations.Qh4: Black brings the queen out early and puts pressure on the e4-pawn.
explanations.Nb5: White's knight puts pressure on the c7 and d6 squares.
explanations.Bb4+: Black gives check with the bishop and gains a tempo for development.
explanations.Qxe4+: Black's queen captures the pawn with check.

variations.name: Millennium Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Bc5 5. Nxc6 Qf6 6. c3 Nge7 7. Bc4 Qg6 8. O-O d6

explanations.Bc5: Black develops the bishop and puts pressure on the knight on d4.
explanations.Nxc6: White's knight captures the knight on c6.
explanations.Qf6: Black develops the queen to an active square.
explanations.c3: White gains central space and supports development.
explanations.Qg6: Black's queen moves toward the kingside.

variations.name: Blumenfeld Attack
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Bc5 5. Be3 Qf6 6. Nb5 Bxe3 7. fxe3 Qh4+ 8. g3 Qd8 9. Qg4 Kf8 10. Qf4 d6

explanations.Be3: White develops the bishop and supports the knight on d4.
explanations.Qf6: Black's queen puts pressure on the center and kingside.
explanations.Nb5: White's knight targets the c7 and d6 squares.
explanations.Bxe3: After the knight leaves d4, Black's bishop captures the white bishop.

variations.name: Romanishin Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Bc5 5. Nb3 Bb4+ 6. c3 Be7 7. c4 Nf6 8. Nc3 O-O 9. Be2 Re8 10. O-O a5 11. a4 d6 12. Be3 Nd7 13. Nb5 Bf6 14. Qc2 Nb4

explanations.Bc5: Black develops the bishop and targets the knight.
explanations.Nb3: White moves the knight out of attack.
explanations.Bb4+: Black gives check with the bishop and gains a tempo for development.
explanations.c3: White challenges the bishop and forces it to choose a square.
explanations.Be7: Black retreats the bishop and continues development safely.
